synopsis: Immediately after the ruined-way-station battle, Falanaras, Rynel, Theron, and Lethira reach a forward command post where restored Eversong meets the Ghostlands and report directly to Ranger-General Halduron Brightwing. Halduron responds warily to the unannounced Argent Dawn incursion, Serenya Duskrunner’s Forsaken Dark Rangers, the postbattle standoff, and Rynel’s evasiveness about how much magic he consumed. A courier from Silvermoon interrupts the debrief with Kael’thas’s sealed request for reinforcements, naming Rynel for a secret Outland mission. Halduron orders the exhausted unit to spend one full day resting inside the camp. The next morning, analysis of the recovered command focus reveals Deatholme’s linked ward-anchor network and an administrative register beneath its eastern ruins. The summons hangs over the team as they undertake this final covert duty. Inside Deatholme, Rynel loses control of his magical hunger and feeds compulsively from Scourge spellcasters, breaking stealth and exposing gaunt, hunched, overbright-eyed signs of early Wretched degeneration beneath his military discipline. The team reaches a records vault and recovers partial intelligence, but an alarm seals their withdrawal and forces them deeper into the stronghold.
title: Chapter 5: The Summons and the March
